files_changed_self_report.rationale: Switched CI runtime resolution to the lockfile-backed SCP runtime checkout, added downstream-safe runtime checkout, and aligned Conftest verification with the local path.
Enabled strict shell mode, added configurable policy-root support for reusable-workflow callers, and re-verified runtime binaries before execution.
Hardened testing-only overrides, added CI-parity changed-file mode and help text, tightened cache permissions, and exported runtime verification metadata.
Stopped blindly forwarding sensitive override env vars and required explicit opt-in for passing them through.
Added coverage for override stripping/rejection and base/head diff parity, and updated existing tests for explicit override opt-in.

self_reported_concerns: The reusable-workflow runtime checkout path now depends on `github.action_repository` and `github.action_ref`; this was not exercised in a live GitHub Actions run during local verification.

The code now documents and enforces testing-only override behavior in the script and Python entrypoint, but the related adopter-guide documentation mentioned in review feedback was out of scope for this slice and was not edited.
codex_structured_result.summary: Closed the reported MAJ findings for slice 020B.2 in code. The reusable workflow now checks out the SCP runtime repo, reads OPA and Conftest digests from `scripts/scp-policy-check.lock`, verifies the extracted Conftest binary, and sources the shared invocation library from the runtime checkout. The local `scripts/scp-policy-check` path now hardens testing-only overrides behind an explicit `--allow-env-overrides` flag, documents CI-parity base/head diff mode in `--help`, uses CI-identical changed-file discovery when `SCP_BASE_SHA` and `SCP_HEAD_SHA` are set, tightens cache permissions, and exports runtime-binary verification metadata. The shared lib now enforces strict shell mode, supports an injected policy root for downstream callers, and re-verifies runtime binaries immediately before execution. The Python wrapper strips sensitive override env vars unless explicitly allowed, and the script test suite now covers override hardening and base/head diff parity. All required verification commands passed.
